body: Preflight main-health returned MAIN_CI_STATUS=error (detail: no matching push workflow runs). Cause: .github/workflows/ci.yaml (name: CI) triggers only on workflow_dispatch and pull_request, so the probe query (workflow=CI, branch=main, event=push) always returns zero runs in this repo; the classifier emits skip only when the workflow is absent entirely. Operator reviewed and waived the gate for this run: main was green on all recent CI pull_request runs and all recent Release push runs. PR CI gating via the pull_request trigger remains in effect for this run.

- **Step 2 (question)**: Implementer returned needs_qa with 4 blockers. Orchestrator verified all claims against the code and retrieved the current Claude Code hooks docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md, 2026-07-16). Verification found the issue #109 rule table is factually wrong in several places. Asked operator: correct-facts-and-implement, halt-and-redesign, or implement-verbatim?
  **A**: Correct facts and implement, AND file an issue detailing every wrong/skipped rule with context and reasons. Dropped CC-HK-002/010/014/017/019 (premises false or undocumented); narrowed CC-HK-015/021/004+018; CC-HK-001 now uses the docs-verified 30-event list instead of the issue's 15.

- **Step 2 (question)**: Skill/agent frontmatter hooks (surfaces 3-4) need structured YAML; crate has 6 deps and no YAML parser; frontmatter.rs is line-based flat-scalar only. Defer, add dependency, or hand-roll a parser?
  **A**: Defer surfaces 3-4 to the strict-YAML issue and update it with the new work, conditional on that issue not already being in flight. Orchestrator verified issue #115 is OPEN with no [IMPLEMENTING] prefix, so the condition is satisfied and the deferral stands. Acceptance criterion 1 (all four surfaces) is knowingly narrowed by operator decision.

- **Step 2 (question)**: How should .claude/settings.local.json appear in the rule registry: new rule code, or reuse H006?
  **A**: New rule code plus a new settings_local_json context field mirroring settings_json. H006 and its docs text stay untouched; H004/H005 scope is not extended (documented as a deliberate gap).
